title: Drop the unused residual value column from offers
description: offers.residual_value_cents was stored for a dealer export that was switched off in August. Nothing reads it and it can always be recomputed (the quote endpoint does). Migration drops it; Offer no longer writes it. Test checks the column is gone.

defects.explanation: Drops the column in the same release that stops writing it: while the migration runs and old instances are still serving, their saves write residual_value_cents and fail. Stop writing it first and drop the column in a later release.
